title: Ember-Born Academy
author: Sora Lindqvist
synopsis: At Solis Citadel, every mage is judged by the color of their spark. Orphaned blacksmith apprentice Rowan lights the Awakening Brazier with a cold blue ash-flame that hasn't been seen since the fall of the First Dragon Riders—earning him a reluctant scholarship and a target on his back.

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Cold Fire
chapters.content:
Everyone knew fire was supposed to burn orange, gold, or—if you were blessed by an Arch-Duke's bloodline—blinding solar white.

When Rowan pressed his blistered palm onto the obsidian Awakening Stone in the center of the amphitheater, the brazier did not roar. It inhaled.

A hush fell over three hundred robed initiates as frost spiderwebbed across the stone basin, followed by a tall, silent spire of sapphire flame that cast silver shadows instead of dark ones. High above the marble balcony, the Grand Dean dropped his ivory staff.

comments.text: What a hook! The atmosphere in Chapter 1: Cold Fire completely pulled me in. Thanks for the chapter!
